text: {"claims":[{"cid":"c1","text":"Nuclear power plants emit no greenhouse gases during operation.","cited_pids":["8ef6c9360938#3"]},{"cid":"c2","text":"Nuclear power's life-cycle emissions are similar to wind's and about a third of solar's per unit of electricity.","cited_pids":["8ef6c9360938#3"]},{"cid":"c3","text":"The IAEA reports that nuclear output, along with renewables and fuel switching, helped level global CO2 emissions in 2019.","cited_pids":["7e88e103d8fb#0"]},{"cid":"c4","text":"Experts argue that limiting warming to 1.5°C would be much harder without a larger role for nuclear power.","cited_pids":["8ef6c9360938#3"]},{"cid":"c5","text":"A Boston University study finds nuclear plants have the highest construction risk, with an average cost overrun of 102.5%.","cited_pids":["06384d0fb532#2"]},{"cid":"c6","text":"A Boston University study finds solar projects have the best track record among energy projects.","cited_pids":["06384d0fb532#3"]},{"cid":"c7","text":"Nuclear power has grown more expensive over time while renewables have fallen in cost.","cited_pids":["3f84053483c2#0"]},{"cid":"c8","text":"An arXiv model of Sweden finds little cost benefit from reinvesting in nuclear power.","cited_pids":["6b0ccdbcf9aa#1"]}]}
